_doc: Commissions (Commission, scripts/systems/commission.gd): a request's building step as a brief. In quests.json a step {kind: "commission", zone?, musts, wishes?, plan?} is done when every must is met; give `hangout` instead to make one of the village's places the site, or leave both out for "anywhere in the village": then the pieces that count are the best group built together (each within `together` metres of another). Musts and wishes are checks: {check, label, ...}. pieces {any, count?, with?}: that many of these pieces in the site (with: one of them must be among them). provides {kind, count?}: pieces that give a seat, light, green, shelter or a stall (an electric lamp only when lit). path {zone?}: a walkable path across the site from one end to the other. fed {target}: water or power reaches that machine target (the fountain). lit {count?}: electric lamps lit. recolored {count?}: painted pieces. material {of}: every piece in the site made mainly of these (its largest cost). kinds {count}: different pieces. count {count}: pieces in all. taller {height}: metres from the lowest piece's bottom to the highest top. A wish has `who`, the villager who wants it. When the request is handed in, the permit is stamped by how many wishes were met (`stamps`: none, some, all), and each wish met gives `wish.harmony` approval and `wish.hearts` hearts with whoever wished it.
